observations: body L1-L11: the end of the Emendanda to the third volume, begun on p. XXX: the pages of the Arabic text in Arabic-Indic numerals and its lines in European numerals, the Arabic set right to left inside the Latin lines as printed. The lines run the full measure without indent. «xx» (L1) and «xxx» (L10) are small capitals. The dashes measure 8.9-10.4 pt.

body L1: «الاوسط» ends the correction to p. ٩٥, l. 16, begun at the foot of p. XXX: the line reads «يكون بقدر تعديله الأوْسَط». The first numeral is «١١٢»: its third digit has its flag on the right, as ٢. On p. ١١٢, l. 4 the edition prints «على حَدَّته»; the correction «حِدَته» has a kasra under the ḥā' and a fatḥa over the dāl, without a shadda. P. ١٣٧, l. 1 begins with «القمر», for which «سمت القمر» is read; p. ١٦١, l. 3 has «فخُذْ حاصَّة الشمس», for which «القمر» is read (L2).

body L2: on p. ١٨١ the edition prints «المتأَخِّرْون», with a round sukūn over the rā', on the eighteenth line of the page as its margin numbers count (with the empty lines about the heading of chapter 50). The correction is printed «المتأَخرون», with the hamza and the fatḥa over the alif and no other sign; a dot (1.0 pt) high over the khā' is a speck. On p. ١٨٩, l. 7 the edition reads «ثمّ الحُوت فيها لد كوكبًا فيها الفَرْغ المُقَدَّم والفَرْغ المُؤَخَّر فجميع...»; «والرِّشَاء», al-Rishā', the twenty-eighth lunar mansion, is to be added after the two Farghs. «المؤَخَّر» has the hamza and fatḥa over the wāw and a shadda with a fatḥa over the khā'; «والرِّشَاء» a shadda with a kasra on the rā' and a fatḥa over the shīn. The stop after it prints small (0.7 pt) and raised.
body L3: on p. ١٩١, l. 3 the edition has «ونَحْوَه», for which «او نحوه» is read. On p. ١٩٨ the words «في الأقاليم» stand on the fifth line of the text, the eighth of the page by its margin numbers.

body L3-L5: on p. ٢٠٢, l. 3-4 the edition reads «...بهذا العَمَل الذي وصَفْتُ لك فما حصل...»; after «الذي وصفت لك» the correction restores «فما كان ٱضربه في ازمان ساعات الجزء التالي», whose alif in «ٱضربه» carries the waṣla, printed as in the Arabic text (for example «ٱعْمِدْ», p. ١٣٧, l. 1).

body L5-L7: on p. ٢١٠, l. 2 the edition reads «...انتهَيْنا في هذا الكتاب الى هذا الموضِع فوصَفْنا الآلة...»; for «فوصفنا» the correction puts the reading of the codex. «كلّ» has a shadda; «يقـدَّم» a shadda with a fatḥa over the dāl, and its elongated join is transcribed with a tatweel; «ذكرُهُ» has a ḍamma over the rā' and over the hā'.

body L7: on p. ٢١٢, l. 13 the edition reads «ثمّ نحيِّز ... حِيزًا»; the correction «نحُزّ ... حَزًّا» agrees with «ثمّ نحُزَّ ... حَزَّيْن», l. 20, and «ونحُزّ», p. ٢١٣, l. 10. Three spaced dots stand between the two words of each reading; «حيزًا» has the tanwīn of the accusative, «حَزًّا» a fatḥa over the ḥā' and a shadda with the tanwīn. A space follows the comma of «٢١٢, 13».

body L8: on p. ٢١٧, l. 10 the edition has «خطّ الشَّاقول», for which «خيط الشاقول» is read; no comma follows «10». On p. ٢٢٤ the edition prints «تسيُّر» in «في تسيُّر الهَيْلاج», the eleventh line of the page by its margin numbers; «تسيير» is read, the codex having «تسير».
body L9: on p. ٢٢٩, col. I the edition prints «بطلميوس أَرْنَب», Nallino's emendation of the codex's «اربيا»; the correction reads «ارنبا».

body L10: the elongated join of «العـــرف» is transcribed with tatweels; «الشُّورَى» has a shadda with a ḍamma over the shīn and a fatḥa over the rā'. «19 5–197» is printed with a space between «19» and «5»; its long dash measures 5.4 pt.

body: the tailpiece closes the front matter of Part II: a thin rule (0.60 pt) swelling into three bulbs in the middle, a long lens, an oval and a long lens, one piece of ink 127.0 pt wide and 3.5 pt high in the print, its middle 0.4 pt left of the middle of the measure. It is redrawn from the print (figures/AB01-PDF0448-F01.tex): its outline traced and smoothed, the slope of the scan (0.16°) taken out, and enlarged in the ratio of the measures, as the head ornament of p. V. Specks in the blank space of the page are not transcribed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
